summary: Papinelle is a Sydney sleepwear brand owned by Quadrant Private Equity since 2021. A 2026 trade report says sales grew 31 per cent and US revenue is on par with Australia. Andrew Milln has been CFO since October 2023.

sources.title: How Papinelle has tripled in size since 2020
Quadrant takes control of Papinelle to drive international expansion
The Aussie pyjamas brand that has seen a 30 per cent increase in sales this year: Papinelle

claims.text: Papinelle is a Sydney sleepwear and loungewear brand founded in 2003, headquartered in Paddington.
claims.quote: Papinelle is an Australian Sleepwear & Lifestyle Brand based in Paddington, Sydney.

claims.text: Andrew Milln is Chief Financial Officer of Papinelle, in the role since October 2023.
Papinelle was acquired by Quadrant Private Equity in 2021 (Quadrant Growth Fund took a controlling stake).
claims.quote: Private-equity company Quadrant Growth Fund has bought a controlling stake in Sydney-headquartered sleepwear and loungewear label Papinelle

claims.text: Andrew's LinkedIn describes him as a CPA-qualified CFO and transformation specialist who partners with ownership and boards; he was previously CFO of Modibodi, also a Quadrant portfolio company.
claims.quote: Chief Financial Officer | Seasoned executive | Transformation specialist | Strategic and operational focus

claims.text: Ragtrader reported in April 2026 that Papinelle posted 31 per cent year-on-year growth and has tripled in size over six years.
claims.quote: Papinelle has just posted a 31 per cent year-on-year growth in 2026, with the brand tripling in size over the last six years

claims.text: CEO John Kelly said North American revenue is about on par with Australia, sold online and through Nordstrom and Anthropologie.
claims.quote: North American market revenue is pretty much on par in size with Australia

claims.text: Papinelle sells through its own online site, five stores across the Eastern states and stockists such as David Jones, and recently opened a Bondi store.
claims.quote: Recently we have opened further standalone retail in Bondi
Tech Stack: adobe, adobe creative suite, canva, figma, shopify, facebook, amp, well, impact, linkedin

claims.text: 7NEWS reports Papinelle is the number-one-selling sleepwear brand at David Jones and stocked at Saks Fifth Avenue, Nordstrom and Victoria's Secret.
claims.quote: number-one-selling sleepwear brand at David Jones

hooks.text: 31% growth and US revenue now on par with Australia across DTC, stores and department-store wholesale means more channels and currencies to reconcile
Andrew's transformation-focused CFO profile and PE-board reporting context

risks.text: Quadrant Private Equity owns Papinelle, so tool choices may be set at group level
Andrew was previously CFO at another Quadrant portfolio company; may be loyal to existing processes

gaps: No posts by Andrew Milln found
Xero/ERP and recs tooling not confirmed publicly
